name: InfraQuote
description: Prepare tour quotations for Amsterdam, Netherlands, in EUR or Abu Dhabi, UAE, in AED. Bring guest requirements, attraction references, supplier costs and margin review into one workflow.
output: Cost worksheet, margin review and client quotation
status: Static MVP · Amsterdam and Abu Dhabi
summaryProblem: Tour quotations become risky when guest requirements, supplier costs, vehicle assumptions, tickets, VAT, margin and client terms live in separate calculations.
summaryContribution: I structured the quotation journey, commercial calculations, internal controls and separation between cost review and client output.
summaryAudience: DMC sales teams, travel consultants and quotation reviewers.
summaryBoundary: Portfolio demonstration using sample or browser-local inputs. Production results have not been established.
